summary.continueHere: Read the rest of the story here
summary.noDetail: The feed has nothing more on this story — open the article for the rest.

gate.allOffBody: Turn on at least one source and its stories will appear here.
gate.offlineBody: There are no saved stories yet. We'll fetch the news as soon as you're back online.
gate.emptyBody: The feeds haven't arrived yet. Refresh now, or check back in a moment.

filters.label: Filters
filters.noMatchBody: Try a longer time range or remove a filter or two.

home.digestDescription: Stories several outlets are covering, one card each — who said what, side by side.

digest.title: Digest
digest.description: Every story several outlets are covering, in one card with each outlet's own headline — no clicking needed.
digest.emptyBody: Stories covered by more than one outlet will gather here. Check back shortly.
digest.soloBody: Stories only one outlet has led with so far.

latest.title: Latest
latest.description: Every story from your sources, minute by minute.

breaking.title: Breaking
breaking.description: Straight from your sources' breaking-news feeds.
breaking.emptyBody: When something breaks, it will show up here first.

forYou.title: For You
forYou.descriptionWithCity: Stories picked for your interests and for {{city}}.
forYou.pickTitle: What do you want to follow?
forYou.pickBody: Pick a few topics and your feed will follow them. You can change them any time.
forYou.emptyBody: Try adding a few more topics, or check back shortly.

history.title: From your reading
history.body: What stands out in the stories you have read lately. Worked out on this device only and never sent anywhere.
history.learning: Read a few stories and your feed will learn from them too ({{count}} of {{min}} so far). Worked out on this device only.
history.nothing: Nothing stands out in your reading yet: the feed follows your interests and location.
history.off: Off: the feed follows only your interests and location.

local.title: Local News
local.chooseBody: Which city do you want to follow? Open a region and pick your province.
local.chooseBody_state: Which state do you want to follow? Open a region and pick your state.
local.chooseBody_land: Which state do you want to follow? Open a region and pick your state.
local.chooseBody_area: Which area do you want to follow? Open a region and pick your area.
local.description: Everything about {{city}}, plus its local outlets.
local.regionDescription: Stories about the provinces in your region.
local.regionDescription_state: Stories about the states in your region.
local.regionDescription_land: Stories about the states in your region.
local.regionDescription_area: Stories about the areas in your region.

markets.title: Markets
markets.description: The currencies, metals, crypto and companies you follow, with their news. Prices and news refresh every minute.
markets.noChange: No change figure from the source
markets.failed: Prices are out of reach right now; trying again shortly.
markets.emptyBody: Add the currencies, metals, crypto and companies you want to follow.
markets.sources: Sources: currencies — European Central Bank reference rates (via Frankfurter, once every working day); metals — gold-api.com; crypto — Binance public market data; gold’s 24-hour change — PAX Gold on Binance. Stock prices are licensed, so companies are followed through their news.
markets.disclaimer: For information only, not investment advice. Prices may be delayed.

category.emptyBody: Stories on this topic will show up here as they arrive.

source.emptyTitle: No stories from this source yet
source.emptyBody: Its feeds will be checked on the next refresh.

search.title: Search
search.startBody: Search runs over headlines and summaries. Accents are optional — “istanbul” finds “İstanbul”, “sao paulo” finds “São Paulo”.
search.noResultsBody: Try different or fewer words. Phrases in quotes are matched exactly.
search.noResultsFiltered: Your filters may be hiding some results.

saved.title: Saved
saved.description: Stories you set aside for later.
saved.emptyBody: Use the bookmark on any story to keep it here.

history.title: History
history.description: Stories you've opened, most recent first.
history.emptyBody: Stories you open will be listed here, day by day.
history.clearBody: The list of stories you've read will be removed. Saved stories stay. This can't be undone.

story.goneBody: It dropped out of the current news, or the outlets that carried it are switched off.
